name: architecture-agent
description: Generate and revise editable architectural Rhino models using retained Python and portable or local browser previews.

interface.longDescription: A source beta for multimodal architectural modeling with retained Python, native Rhino files and portable or local browser previews. Uses rhino3dm and Shapely without a Rhino application or hosted geometry service. A compatible Python execution host builds models; recipients can open a downloaded self-contained HTML preview in a desktop browser. Advanced RhinoCommon and GH generation are outside this backend.
defaultPrompt: Design an editable courtyard house and show its browser preview.
Build a Rhino model from these plans and sections.
Revise the floor height while preserving earlier model versions.
